name: early_session
description: time_ratio = 0.1 (10% of the session elapsed; ~39 minutes after the 9:30 ET open in a standard 390-minute session). Decay is already ~28% complete at 10% wall-clock — this is the concavity of log10 doing the work the spec calls for (early-day tightening). Catches an impl that used linear decay or an off-by-scaling-factor inside log10.
